Title: AI/ML Risk Classification Tiers (Article 4)
Left-side vertical axis text (arrow, bottom to top): Increasing regulatory scrutiny
Three-tier pyramid, top to bottom:
Tier 1 (top, red): HIGH — Credit pricing agents · loan approval models · fraud decisioning. Below: Mandatory validation before deployment; annual re-validation
Tier 2 (middle, gold): MEDIUM — Customer segmentation · churn prediction · internal risk dashboards. Below: Required within 6 months of deployment; biennial
Tier 3 (bottom, green): LOW — Document classification · OCR · internal helpdesk chatbots. Below: Not mandated; recommended at management discretion

items.transcription:
Title: GERNAS Pricing Agent — Mandatory Human-in-the-Loop Control Flow
Subtitle (italic): Per CBUAE Circular 2024/BSE/047, Article 5 — HIGH-risk AI/ML systems
Main flow, left to right, 4 boxes: 1. AI Recommendation — Pricing Agent generates rate + RAROC + explanation. 2. Reviewer Access — Full inputs, reasoning, policy context (Art. 5.1.2). 3. Human Review — Floor check · policy check · independent assessment. 4. Decision — Approve / Override
Right column, top to bottom: 5. Approved (green, no body text). 6. Override Logged — Reason required. 7. Audit Log — Reviewer ID · timestamp / 7-yr retention (Art 5.1.3)
Bottom red box (arrow from Audit Log back toward main flow): Override rate > 25% (90-day rolling) — escalate to AI Risk Officer (Art. 5.2.2)

Title: FAB Credit Risk Governance — Three Lines of Defense Model
Subtitle (italic): Standard banking governance structure underpinning credit pricing controls

1ST LINE / Business & Operations: Relationship Managers; Credit Analysts; GERNAS Pricing Agent (as a business tool); Product Management. Caption: Owns and manages risk day-to-day
2ND LINE / Risk & Compliance Oversight: Group Risk Management; AI Risk Officer; Model Risk Management team; Credit Committees (RCC/CCC/GCC). Caption: Sets policy, monitors, challenges 1st line

Bottom banner (amber): "The GERNAS Pricing Agent sits in the 1st line as a tool — but its outputs are independently reviewed (2nd line) and periodically validated (3rd line), per CBUAE Art. 3.2 & 5.1"

Title: FAB Credit Pricing — Approval Authority Escalation Path
Subtitle (italic): Escalation is driven by facility size and client credit rating (Policy §5.1)
Vertical flow, top to bottom, boxes connected by downward arrows:
1. Relationship Manager + Credit Analyst — Up to AED 25M · all ratings
2. Senior RM + Team Head — AED 25M–100M · AAA to BBB
3. Segment Credit Head — AED 25M–100M (BB & below) or AED 100M–500M (AAA–BBB)
4. Regional Credit Committee (RCC) — AED 100M–500M · BB and below
5. Country Credit Committee (CCC) — AED 500M–1 billion · all ratings
6. Group Credit Committee (GCC) — title visible, but box is visually overlapped by the amber footer banner beneath it; no additional criteria text is legible under the GCC title in this image
Footer banner (amber, overlapping the GCC box): "Pricing Exceptions (below-floor pricing) follow a SEPARATE escalation ladder — see §6.2"
